verdict.rationale: AutoGen Studio's UI-built agent teams can be exported and run as Python code (autogen-docs-5), and the core AgentChat API (agents, teams, tools, memory, human-in-the-loop) is fully documented as code-first (autogen-docs-1,2,3,10,11,12,13,14), showing strong UI-to-API parity for team building. However, some Studio-only features like the community component gallery (autogen-docs-8) and interactive testing environment (autogen-docs-7) aren't shown to have a documented equivalent API path. Missing for 10: explicit documentation confirming every Studio feature (gallery, live testing/debugging) has a matching programmatic API, and independent verification of full parity.
